Agent Name: Planner
 Step Number: 7
 Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the cited Wikipedia source and incorrectly identified Archduke Leopold Salvator’s mother as Archduchess Maria Theresa of Austria, despite the WebSurfer’s page clearly stating “Princess Maria Immaculata of Bourbon-Two Sicilies.” This misinterpretation of the genealogy (confusing similarly named Habsburg figures) led to a wrong interim conclusion about Dolores’s paternal grandmother.
